Name: Janoah in Naphtali
ModernLocation: Unknown; in northern Israel (Yanouh and Yanuh both proposed)
Description: A town of Naphtali taken by Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria in the days of Pekah, listed with Ijon, Abel-beth-maachah, Kedesh, Hazor, Gilead and Galilee, whose people were carried captive to Assyria.
BiblicalSignificance: Janoah's capture is part of the first Assyrian deportation from the north, the beginning of the end for the northern kingdom.
RelatedPeople: Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria; Pekah, King of Israel
